Measure launched-data +both wire legs +metadata combinational arcs +capture/hold with actual per-root phase; individual <=500um wires do not prove this path.
critical_timing_obligations.calendar_qualification: Calendar/VMB rank_valid/slot/index can cross metadata combinationally into payload input/enable pins. Destination_index is a direct4-bit pass-through; no register was invented.
